items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: They, they're older than I am. Pete's about three years older than I am. ... So they were, uh, they were grown men, see, when we were just kids.

ctx.x: Oh, gee, you'd run into all kind of, uh, musicians. At that time, uh, well, we were kids and they, you know, weren't really on, on, uh, not that we weren't on speaking terms, but we weren't socially involved with the older musicians. Mm-hmm. They would come in, take care of their business and, uh, leave. Yeah. But mostly with, uh, just the kids that I grew up with and other young musicians in the area would go be in there, you know.
But people like George Girard and Pete Frattner with the Basin Street Six, were they older or younger?

They, they're older than I am. Pete's about three years older than I am. Mm-hmm. And George was about, oh, two or three years older than Pete. Mm-hmm. So they were, uh, they were grown men, see, when we were just kids. Yeah, you had that idea. Oh, yeah, they were, you know, untouchables.
